headline: Road Rash Rebuilt in Pure Vanilla JS
text:
Remember Road Rash? We rebuilt the 90s motorcycle combat racer in pure vanilla JS with pseudo-3D road physics.

Pin the throttle, swing a club, and dodge traffic. Zero downloads, instant load:

https://kreeda.games/road-rumble/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiegame
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced, 4-second looping GIF showing a high-speed curve, punching an opponent off their bike directly into an oncoming civilian truck, and speeding away.
